_note: Transcribed from IRS documents; see VERIFICATION.md V21. Amounts in current dollars of each year.

currentLaw.source: IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32, sections 3.01 (Tables 1 and 3) and 3.14; https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-drop/rp-25-32.pdf
currentLaw.exemptionSource: IRS Publication 15-T (2026): withholding reflects the permanent termination of personal exemptions (P.L. 119-21).

1953.source: Statistics of Income 1953 Part 1 (https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-soi/53soireppt1ar.pdf): optional standard deduction, the smaller of $1,000 or 10 percent of adjusted gross income ($500 for a married person filing separately).

1963.source: Statistics of Income 1963 (https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-soi/63inar.pdf): 10 percent of income as standard deduction, limited to $1,000 or $500 on a separate return of husband or wife; $600 per exemption.

1980.source: Statistics of Income 1980 (https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-soi/80inar.pdf): zero bracket amount $3,400 married filing jointly, $2,300 single, built into the tax tables and rate schedules.
